Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.graph

Class Edge

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.observer.AbstractObservable
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.graph.Edge
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable, Serializable
public class Edge extends AbstractObservable
An edge connecting two Nodes in the concert-hall graph.

Edges are where bottlenecks happen: at most maxConcurrentAgents agents (both directions combined) may travel along an edge at the same time. An edge may be directed (one-way), may speed up or slow agents down, and may be blocked dynamically (fire, debris, crowd).

The chosen capacity policy is "check before entering": an agent only steps onto an edge if hasRoom() is true; otherwise it waits.

Version:
1.0
Author:
GROUPE E

  • Constructor Details

    • Edge

      public Edge(String id, Node source, Node target, boolean directed, int maxConcurrentAgents)
      Creates an edge between two nodes. The length defaults to the Euclidean distance between the two endpoints.
      Parameters:
      id - unique identifier of the edge
      source - source node; never null
      target - target node; never null
      directed - true if the edge is one-way (source to target)
      maxConcurrentAgents - how many agents may travel on it simultaneously (>= 1)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if endpoints are null, equal, or capacity < 1
